messages:
Renee M.: Quick kickoff  were launching LumenKit (new refapp) + a short webinar showing the tutorial + a lightbench. Need owners for blog, bench writeup, webinar ops, and lead routing.
Omar S.: I can own the webinar ops (registration + invites). Prefer Tue Jun 2 10am PT.
Priya D.: Ill write the OSS launch post and create the 5-min quickstart gif. Need headline & three key numbers from Leo by Mon.
Leo T.: Ill run the bench and send a short metrics sheet: median latency, cost/1M tokens, and an embed throughput number. Will redact infra names.
Renee M.: Can legal require embargo? If so we need to know before writing social.
Leo T.: Legal asked to review reproducibility notes. Ill put full run scripts in a private repo branch and publish after sign-off.
Omar S.: Ops: HubSpot form fields we need: name, email, company, role, primary intent (PoC/eval/prod). Also add utm params: utm_source=social&utm_campaign=lumenkit_launch and utm_content=bench_card.
Priya D.: Social plan: 1) repo announcement 2) bench highlight card 3) tutorial gif. Draft tweet: "LumenKit: tiny refapp for prototyping inference. Try it, clone it, join our Jun 2 webinar to see results. https://go.redwood.ai/lumenkit?utm_campaign=lumenkit_launch&utm_content=bench_card"
Ops-bot: Reminder created: "LumenKit webinar page" due 2026-06-01.
Renee M.: Good. Owners & deadlines: Leo - bench metrics + private PR (due Mon 09:00). Priya - blog + assets (due Wed EOD). Omar - reg page + emails (due Fri).
Leo T.: Bench summary (for blog): chat median ~120ms, cost ~ $10 / 1M tokens; embed throughput 300 reqs/s on our test rig. Full logs in repo.
Priya D.: Ill include a CTA "Quickstart in 5 mins" gif and link to the repo + community Discord.
Omar S.: Will draft confirmation and reminders. Also adding a HubSpot webhook to tag contacts with "lumenkit_refapp" and notify #leads.
Renee M.: Thanks. If legal requests embargo, pause social and webinar until cleared. Ping this thread with any blockers. :thumbsup:
